flows.title: Every process in MONO
flows.mapHint: Each box is a process. An arrow means one hands over to the next. Tap a box to see its steps.
flows.lifeHint: Drawn from the rules MONO runs, so it always matches the app. Dashed boxes lead into another process — tap one to open it.
flows.rules: The steps are fixed by how MONO works; their alerts are set in Notification rules.
flows.fmsHint: Processes your company built in the FMS Builder, drawn step by step.
flows.hospOff: Restaurant, hotel and banquet processes appear once Hospitality is switched on.

d.delegation: A one-time task: given, accepted, done, verified.
d.checklist: Recurring work made by the schedule, ticked and verified.
d.slip: A problem with solutions, decided by an approver; the chosen fix becomes a task.
d.ticket: An issue raised to a problem solver, fixed with proof, escalated when late.
d.ea: The owner's capture board, sorted by the EA.
d.leave: Asked by the person, Buddy found for their work, decided by the HOD or HR.
d.buddy: A colleague is asked to look after work while someone is away.
d.cover: The away person's work moves to the Buddy and comes back.
d.crm_plan: The year's sales target, approved by the owner.
d.lead: An enquiry qualified into a lead, moved through the funnel, won or lost.
d.call: A SCOT or win-back call to a customer, with its result.
d.sales_order: An order taken, run through the after-order steps, invoiced and collected.
d.purchase_order: Ordered from a vendor, received in part or in full; a purchase bill follows.
d.stock_transfer: One branch asks another for stock: approved, sent, received, differences settled.
d.production_order: Made from a recipe: ingredients out, the product in.
d.stock_adjustment: Damaged, expired, lost or found stock waits for an approver.
d.stock_count: A location is counted; differences wait for approval.
d.audit_count: The top items by value are counted each cycle.
d.bill: Any paper with money: invoice, receipt, advance, purchase bill, credit note.
d.reservation: A table booked by phone, walk-in or online, deposit if needed, then seated.
d.waitlist: Walk-ins waiting for a table, called back when it frees.
d.pos_order: A table or takeaway order from opening to the paid bill.
d.pos_order_item: Each dish: held, fired to the kitchen, ready, served, or voided.
d.kot: A ticket on the kitchen screen, bumped when it goes out.
d.pos_check: One bill of an order: paid by cash, card, UPI, room or company.
d.stay: A room booking from reservation to check-in, the folio and check-out.
d.room_hk: A room after the guest: dirty, cleaned, inspected, or blocked for repair.
d.hk_task: A cleaning task with its checklist, inspected by the supervisor.
d.banquet: An event from enquiry to quotation, advance, BEO, the day and the final bill.

link.roomCharge: Room charge on the guest's folio

setup.nothing: This process has nothing of its own to set: it runs by the steps on its chart.

setup.allRules: All the rules for this area
